best_match.fbbt_term: adult insulin secreting cell of pars intercerebralis
best_match.fbbt_definition: Insulin-producing neurosecretory cell of the adult pars intercerebralis that innervates the corpus cardiacum and corpus allatum, and branches before exiting the brain. There are approximately 7-9 of these cells from each hemisphere with their cell bodies clustering in the pars intercerebralis at late pupal stages. These cells co-express Ilp2, Ilp3 and Ilp5 mRNA (Broughton et al., 2005).

justification: Insulin-producing cells = IPCs; adult variant used for adult flies (dilp2-GAL4 sorted).
